newsitem.title: USA: Mother throws her children off roof then leaps.
newsitem.headline: Mother throws her children off roof then leaps.

text.p: A 23-year-old mother threw her three young children off the roof of a 15-story apartment building, killing one of them, before jumping to her own death on Sunday, police said.
One of her children, a boy, Andre Roveal, 7, was killed, while his twin sister, Andrea was in critical condition and a younger boy, Shando, 2 was in serious condition, a police spokesman said.
"The mother, Chicqua Roveal, is believed to have a history of a psychiatric condition and has been distraught recently," the spokesman said.
